直到出了来时的那个三岔口，顾承安还是有点懵。

看着驾驶位上那一张他再熟悉不过的面孔。

“处长，您怎么来了？”

处长从后视镜里瞥了他一眼，语气不咸不淡：“你小子，喊你不要给我丢脸，你确实给我长脸了。”

顾承安刚想谦虚两句，处长话锋一转——

“还是长大脸了。”

“……”

“这大半个月，我是隔二差三的收到你的情况。”

“我要是再不来，你是不是都不准备回来了？”

顾承安立刻摆出一副受伤的表情：“哪能呢处长，您可是我的挚爱亲朋啊，我怎么会舍下您呢？”

处长呵呵一声，那个“呵呵”里包含的信息量极大。

“你看看你干的好事。”处长腾出一只手比划，“海陆空，就差海了。打炮、雷达搜索、高射炮、火箭发射——不对，导弹发射，坦克、直升机、战斗机……好家伙，人家一样东西要学好久，你大半个月全给摸了个遍。”

顾承安试图辩解：“我那不叫摸，叫粗略了解——”

“粗略？”处长声音拔高了好几度，“你管开着直升机在山谷里做蛇形机动叫粗略？你管把坦克开进训练场的水沟里又自己开出来叫粗略？”

“那个水沟是意外……”

“你管拿模拟器打出实弹射击考核满分叫粗略？”

顾承安闭嘴了。

处长深吸一口气，像是在平复什么情绪：“你知道那边的教官怎么跟我说的吗？”

“怎么说的？”

“说他们已经写了联名报告申请要把你留下。”

顾承安眨了眨眼：“这不是好事吗？说明我表现……”

“好个屁。”处长打断他，“那帮人是想把你当实验品研究。一个非军事编制的人，体能数据、反应速度、学习曲线全部超标，你说他们能不眼红？”

顾承安知道处长是在唬他，他可是收了力的！也识趣地没再触霉头，靠回座椅上，嘴角微微翘起。

车子一路畅通，最终开进了一个不起眼小院的一处门前。

顾承安认出这地方——上次武警接收马克西蒙就是在这儿。

处长带着进入面前的大门，穿过走廊，推开其中一扇门。

里面是个简单到近乎简陋的房间，一张办公桌，两把椅子，一个沙发。墙上挂着国旗，桌上摆着一套叠得整整齐齐的警服，旁边还有几个盒子。

Gu Chengan was still a little confused until he came out of the three-way intersection.

Looking at the face in the driver's seat that he knew all too well.

"Director, why are you here?"

The director glanced at him in the rearview mirror and said in a neither salty nor cool tone: "You kid, I told you not to embarrass me. You have indeed given me face."

Just when Gu Chengan was about to say something modest, the director changed the subject——

"You still have a big face."

"..."

"In the past month and a half, I have received reports on your situation every now and then."

"If I don't come back, aren't you even going to come back?"

Gu Chengan immediately put on a hurt expression: "How could you, Director, you are my dearest relative and friend, how could I abandon you?"

The director chuckled, and that "haha" contained a huge amount of information.

"Look at the good things you've done." The director gestured with one hand, "Sea, land and air, the only thing missing is the sea. Artillery, radar search, anti-aircraft guns, rocket launches - no, missile launches, tanks, helicopters, fighter jets... Good guy, it takes a long time to learn something, and you have touched them all for more than half a month."

Gu Chengan tried to argue: "I don't call it touching, it's called a rough understanding——"

"Rough?" The director's voice rose several times. "You call driving a helicopter to make snake-like maneuvers in the valley rough? You call driving a tank into a ditch at the training ground and then driving it out again called rough?"

"That ditch was an accident..."

"You call it rough to get a perfect score in a live-fire shooting assessment using a simulator?"

Gu Chengan shut up.

The director took a deep breath, as if trying to calm down his emotions: "Do you know what the instructor over there told me?"

"What did you say?"

"They said they have written a joint report application to keep you."

Gu Chengan blinked: "Isn't this a good thing? It means that my performance..."

"What a crap." The director interrupted him, "Those people want to use you as a guinea pig for research. For a person who is not part of the military establishment, his physical fitness data, reaction speed, and learning curve are all beyond the standard. Do you think they can not be jealous?"

Gu Chengan knew that the director was bluffing him, but he stopped trying!He also had the good sense not to get into trouble again, and leaned back on his seat, with the corners of his mouth slightly raised.

The car traveled smoothly and finally drove into the door of an inconspicuous courtyard.

Gu Chengan recognized this place - it was here the last time the armed police took Maximon into custody.

The director entered the door in front of him, walked through the corridor, and pushed open one of the doors.

Inside is a simple to almost shabby room, with a desk, two chairs, and a sofa.There is a national flag hanging on the wall, and a neatly folded police uniform is on the table, with several boxes next to it.
